chunks: He (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, is not a wrongdoer to His servants.
And He does not wrong anyone by the weight of an atom.
And He does not wrong anyone by the weight of an atom.

key_terms.مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ: By the weight of an atom

ai.seo_question: What does the Imam say about Allah's justice and wronging His servants?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to ground the Shia doctrine of divine justice (*Adl*) in the Quranic principle that Allah’s judgment is perfectly precise, wronging no one even by the weight of an atom. This hadith serves as a foundational proof for the belief that all trials and rewards are manifestations of divine equity rather than arbitrary decree, reinforcing the theological stance against the Mu'tazila and Ahl al-Sunnah debates on predestination.
